title: Visible handwashing flow for a new-video check

reference.title: Visible handwashing flow for a new-video check
reference.scope: Predeclared visible-action reference for transfer checking, not a hygiene-quality assessment. Unseen actions remain unknown. No expected timestamps are supplied.

steps.label: Wet hands with water
steps.criterion: Running or poured water visibly contacts hands before a visible soap-lather episode. A faucet or sink alone is insufficient.

steps.label: Apply soap to hands
steps.criterion: Hands visibly receive soap from a dispenser, bottle, or bar. Lather alone does not prove application.

steps.label: Rub hands with soap lather
steps.criterion: Hands rub together with visible soap foam; rubbing without visible foam is uncertain.

steps.label: Rinse hands with water
steps.criterion: After visible lather rubbing, water visibly contacts the hands; rubbing beside a faucet is insufficient.

steps.label: Dry hands
steps.criterion: A towel or paper visibly contacts and wipes the hands, or hands are held in a visibly operating air dryer. Holding a towel nearby is insufficient.

steps.reason: At 2 and 4 s the hands cup and turn beneath the visible faucet stream, before the soap-bar contact shown later. Water visibly reaches the hands.
steps.uncertainty: Only sampled images were supplied; exact onset of water contact is not measured.
steps.label: Wet hands with water

steps.reason: The 6 s image shows a greenish soap bar in contact with the hands as the fingers rub or turn it. This is visible application rather than an inferred missing step.
steps.uncertainty: The fingers partially cover the bar; soap amount is not measurable.
steps.label: Apply soap to hands

steps.reason: At 12 s the hands rub together to the right of the flowing stream, with a light whitish soapy patch on the finger/hand surfaces.
steps.uncertainty: Lather is thin at this input resolution; wet highlights and lather are difficult to separate across some other views. No coverage or hygiene-quality claim is made.
steps.label: Rub hands with soap lather

steps.reason: After the cited lather view, the 16, 18 and 24 s images place and rotate the hands through the visibly flowing water from the faucet.
steps.uncertainty: Water also runs earlier; these are post-lather contact samples, not exact action boundaries.
steps.label: Rinse hands with water

steps.reason: At 26 s the hands move away from the faucet, and the 32 s view contains an empty basin and running stream. No wiping with paper or towel or contact with an operating dryer is visible.
steps.uncertainty: The camera does not follow the hands. Drying may occur off camera or between supplied samples.
steps.label: Dry hands

time_note: Cited sample order, not continuous execution or exact action boundaries.
reviewer: Codex vision session: actual sampling within one automatic MCP workflow call
method: MCP sampling: host vision review of supplied reference and timestamped source-frame contact sheets
scope_note: Visible sample evidence only. Not proof of uninterrupted execution, hidden actions, or completeness outside reviewed images.
